ns2:section.sectionText: Successful Storytelling: Designing the Ultimate Pitch, developed by Siebel Center for Design, teaches students storytelling skills with the aim of improving their pitching ability. Whether it’s pitching your project to a manager, selling your startup to investors, or marketing yourself to an employer, students will be equipped to present and persuade like the best. Students participating in the Cozad New Venture Challenge 2020 are encouraged to enroll in this class, although all students interested in storytelling are welcome. Email designcenter@illinois.edu for more information.
